items.text: Eagles officially ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for London game vs Jaguars; one of five OUTs including DeVonta Smith.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practices; official Friday report.
items.implication: Eagles RB room thin after Bigsby also out/IR; heavy reliance on remaining backs and Hurts rushing.
items.opportunity: Lead role/snaps/carries/routes for remaining Eagles RBs (Shipley emphasized by ETR); possible Hurts rush bump.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) officially OUT for Sunday in London vs Jaguars.
items.implication: Reduced WR depth; more targets to Goedert, Brown if active, or others; Hurts may check down or run more.
items.opportunity: Target/route share increase for remaining Eagles pass-catchers including Goedert.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will start vs Giants; WR Stefon Diggs OUT (hamstring). McLaurin trending positively per coach.
items.why: Hamstring; coach/ official confirmation. Daniels cleared to start.
items.implication: Daniels full go boosts Commanders offense; Diggs absence opens short/intermediate targets.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for McLaurin (if active), other WRs/TEs; Daniels rushing/passing volume secure.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson ruled out for Sunday night at Falcons with left ankle injury; Tyler Huntley expected to start. Also OUT: Trey Hendrickson, Cam Jurgens.
items.why: Ankle injury; DNP practices; coach confirmation.
items.implication: Major downgrade for Ravens pass game and Lamar rush upside; Huntley start limits ceiling.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/red-zone for Likely, Andrews, Flowers, Henry in pass-heavy script possible.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) for Sunday vs Browns; second straight miss. Also WR Adonai Mitchell OUT.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup lead; reduced offense efficiency.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love limited in practice for ankle 'maintenance' but says full-go and not on final injury report. Tough projection spot after Week 4 usage criticism; currently 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Risk he sits or cedes more if fatigue.
items.why: Player comments + not on final report; prior media drag on usage may prompt more work or caution.
items.implication: Startable but volatile; monitor for actual snaps/carries vs Allgeier split.
items.opportunity: Potential lead RB role/snaps if healthy and coaches respond to criticism; goal-line/third-down TBD.
items.conflict: Usage data from W4 underwhelming vs projection lead.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including OT Joe Alt, S Derwin James) for Week 5.
items.implication: More targets to remaining Chargers WRs in Herbert offense.
items.opportunity: Route/target share bump for Ladd McConkey and other Chargers receivers.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty listed as questionable on Friday injury report vs Patriots.
items.implication: Monitor for active/inactive; usage uncertain if limited.
items.opportunity: If OUT/INACTIVE, backup RBs (e.g. others in LV) see carries; if IN, full role expected.

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift (hip/knee) has no injury designation for Sunday at Packers; Kyle Monangai ruled OUT.
items.why: No designation after limited/missed time; Monangai OUT clears path.
items.implication: Swift expected full or near-full workload vs GB.
items.opportunity: Secure carries/snaps/third-down for Swift; no committee dilution from Monangai.

items.text: Vikings list WRs Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) as questionable for Sunday vs Saints.
items.why: Ankle for Jefferson, hamstring for Addison; Friday listings.
items.implication: Game-time or late decisions; if both limited/out, major target redistribution in MIN offense.
items.opportunity: If OUT, boost to other Vikings pass-catchers; monitor final status for start/sit.

items.text: ETR/Levitan/Silva: With Barkley and Bigsby out, expect Will Shipley show vs Jacksonville; emphasis on Shipley as primary remaining back for snaps/touches.
items.why: Depth chart collapse; prior snap/route data when Barkley exited; London matchup.
items.implication: Shipley becomes viable RB2/flex with volume; monitor actual split if others elevated.
items.opportunity: High snap share, carries, routes, possible goal-line for Shipley as lead back.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red-zone vs Titans defense that struggles vs WRs.
items.why: Target-hog volume + red-zone + matchup gift vs TEN.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high floor/ceiling in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Sustained high target/route share; red-zone upside.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + Bengals injury context (Chase/Higgins) + soft MIA run defense.
items.why: Heavy workload expected; pass-game pie if WRs limited; MIA allows RB production.
items.opportunity: Carries + targets/routes in potentially pass-heavy or balanced script; goal-line work.
items.conflict: Levitan xFP notes Chase Brown underperforming opportunities earlier.

items.text: Hates Jalen Hurts vs JAX in London as QB15; rough recent stretch + banged-up line + missing Barkley/Smith.
items.why: Inefficiency lately, OL issues, key skill players OUT, London game environment.
items.implication: Sit/fade in favor of other QBs; lower rushing floor possible without complementary pieces.
items.conflict: Hurts still has dual-threat baseline; injuries may force more designed runs.
